formal_statement: have x1 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) := {(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))}; let x2 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → Prop := fun (x2 x3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => ∃ x4 ∈ x1, x2 = x3 + x4; let x3 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ)) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → Prop := fun (x3 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))) (x4 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => ∀ x5 ∈ x3, ¬x2 x5 x4; have x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit → Prop := fun (x4 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => (∀ (x5 x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x2 x5 x6 → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (26 : ℕ) x4 fun (x8 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x8 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x5 ∨ x8 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x6)) = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (x5 : Finset (Fin (13 : ℕ))), (∀ x6 ∉ x5, ∃ (x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x3 x5 x8 ∧ x2 x6 x8) → ((∃ (x7 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), ∀ x8 ∈ x5, x2 x8 x7) ∨ ∃ (x7 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), ∀ (x8 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x3 x5 x8 → x2 x7 x8) → (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (26 : ℕ) x4 fun (x8 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide ((∃ x9 ∈ x5, x8 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x9) ∨ ∃ (x9 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x8 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x9 ∧ x3 x5 x9)) = Bool.false; have x5 : (Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool) → Prop := fun (x5 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool) => ∃ (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), ∀ (x7 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x5 (Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x7) = Bool.true → x7 = x6; ∀ (x6 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x6 → x6.size ≤ (63 : ℕ) → x4 x6 → ∃ (x10 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x10 ∧ x10.size ≤ x6.size ∧ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.HasLineDegree (26 : ℕ) (Finset.Ico (13 : ℕ) (26 : ℕ)) x10 (1 : ℕ) ∧ ∀ (x11 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool), x5 x11 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (26 : ℕ) x10 x11 = PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (26 : ℕ) x6 x11
plain_statement: Plane of order 3. A circuit of AND and OR gates, at most two inputs a gate, with at most 63 gates, true at every incident point-line pair and false at every degenerate maximal false input. Then some circuit of the same kind, no larger, has line-degree at most 1 in the line inputs and agrees with it at every input with at most one line on.
title: A step toward: Order-3 plane: every fan-in-two AND/OR circuit true at incident pairs and false at all degenerate maximal false inputs has at least 64 gates
